items.name: Alcohol
items.shortDescription: A central nervous system depressant that slows down brain activity.

acute.brainImpact: Alcohol interferes with the brain's communication pathways, leading to loss of coordination and lowered inhibitions.

chronic.brainImpact: Long-term heavy alcohol use can shrink the frontal lobes and reduce overall brain volume, impairing memory and cognitive function.

withdrawal.brainImpact: The brain, having adapted to the constant presence of a depressant, goes into a state of hyper-excitability when alcohol is removed.

items.name: Caffeine
items.shortDescription: A central nervous system stimulant that blocks adenosine receptors.

acute.brainImpact: Blocks adenosine receptors, preventing drowsiness and increasing alertness.

items.name: Nicotine
items.shortDescription: A stimulant and relaxant that alters mood and attention.

acute.brainImpact: Activates nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, leading to release of neurotransmitters.

items.name: Meditation
items.shortDescription: Simulate the calming effects of meditation.

chronic.brainImpact: Increases grey matter density and enhances connectivity.

items.name: Sleep Deprivation
items.shortDescription: Simulate the cognitive impairment caused by lack of sleep.

acute.brainImpact: Impairs memory consolidation and emotional regulation.

items.name: Cognitive Overload
items.shortDescription: Simulate the effects of excessive mental effort.

items.name: Physical Activity
items.shortDescription: Simulate the neuroprotective effects of exercise.

acute.brainImpact: Promotes neurogenesis and increases brain plasticity.

items.name: Joy
items.shortDescription: A feeling of great pleasure and happiness.

acute.brainImpact: Activates reward pathways and promotes well-being.

items.name: Fear
items.shortDescription: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

acute.brainImpact: Triggers the fight-or-flight response, preparing the body for action.

items.name: Sadness
items.shortDescription: Emotional pain associated with feeling of disadvantage or loss.

acute.brainImpact: Can reduce overall brain activity in certain areas associated with motivation.

items.name: Alzheimer's
items.shortDescription: A progressive disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions.

chronic.brainImpact: Causes brain cells to degenerate and die, leading to brain shrinkage.

items.name: Parkinson's
items.shortDescription: A disorder of the central nervous system that affects movement.

chronic.brainImpact: Gradual loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the substantia nigra.

items.name: Depression
items.shortDescription: A mood disorder that causes a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest.

chronic.brainImpact: Changes in brain structure and function, particularly in emotional regulation areas.
